COLDWAR_SWE_national_install_palme_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_office_palme
			}
		}
	}
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_office_carlsson
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_office_palme
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				ruling_party = 3
			}
			NOT = {
				has_country_leader = {
					name = "Olof Palme"
					ruling_only = yes
				}
			}
		}
		retire_country_leader = yes
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Olof Palme"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/SWE/SWE_Coldwar_Olof_Palme.dds"
			ideology = socialism
			expire = "2000.1.1"
		}
	}
}

			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_governing_faction_kfml
			NOT = {
				has_country_leader = {
					name = "Roland Pettersson"
					ruling_only = yes
				}
			}
		}
		retire_country_leader = yes
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Roland Pettersson"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/Europe/Portrait_Europe_Generic_1.dds"
			ideology = communist_state
			expire = "2000.1.1"
		}
	}
}

# IMPERIA COLD WAR — No calendar leader changes, 20.11.2026: the historical party succession only advances a party's
#   chairman while that party is out of government (the new chairman takes office when it next forms a government);
#   only the KDS step (death of Birger Ekstedt, 1972) also applies while governing. Player selectors are unchanged.

COLDWAR_SWE_national_sync_government_effect = {
	set_temp_variable = {
		COLDWAR_SWE_previous_identity = COLDWAR_SWE_political_identity
	}
	set_variable = {
		COLDWAR_SWE_political_identity = ruling_party
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				ruling_party = 4
			}
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_governing_faction_apk
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_governing_faction_kfml
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_governing_faction_kfmlr
				}
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_governing_faction_kfml
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				ruling_party = 4
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_governing_faction_apk
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_formed_apk
		}
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_political_identity = 41
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				ruling_party = 4
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_governing_faction_kfml
		}
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_political_identity = 42
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				ruling_party = 4
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_governing_faction_kfmlr
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_formed_kfmlr
		}
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_political_identity = 43
		}
	}
	update_government_coalition_strength = yes
	set_variable = {
		COLDWAR_SWE_parliament_support = government_coalition_strength_elect
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_support_vpk_signed
			check_variable = {
				ruling_party = 3
			}
			NOT = {
				is_in_array = {
					gov_coalition_array = 5
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_parliament_support = party_pop_elect_array^5
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = {
		var = COLDWAR_SWE_parliament_support
		min = 0
		max = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				check_variable = {
					var = COLDWAR_SWE_political_identity
					value = COLDWAR_SWE_previous_identity
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = {
		COLDWAR_SWE_old_cabinet = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_identity
	}
	set_variable = {
		COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_identity = 0
	}
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_non_socialist
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_centre_liberal
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_liberal_minority
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_sap_support
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_green_family
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = {
					ruling_party = 1
				}
				check_variable = {
					ruling_party = 2
				}
				check_variable = {
					ruling_party = 15
				}
			}
			OR = {
				check_variable = {
					ruling_party = 1
				}
				is_in_array = {
					gov_coalition_array = 1
				}
			}
			OR = {
				check_variable = {
					ruling_party = 2
				}
				is_in_array = {
					gov_coalition_array = 2
				}
			}
			OR = {
				check_variable = {
					ruling_party = 15
				}
				is_in_array = {
					gov_coalition_array = 15
				}
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_non_socialist
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_identity = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = {
					ruling_party = 2
				}
				check_variable = {
					ruling_party = 15
				}
			}
			OR = {
				is_in_array = {
					gov_coalition_array = 2
				}
				is_in_array = {
					gov_coalition_array = 15
				}
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_centre_liberal
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_identity = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				ruling_party = 2
			}
			check_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_parliament_support < 0.5
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_liberal_minority
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_identity = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				ruling_party = 3
			}
			OR = {
				is_in_array = {
					gov_coalition_array = 5
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_support_vpk_signed
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_sap_support
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_identity = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = {
					ruling_party = 3
				}
				check_variable = {
					ruling_party = 17
				}
			}
			OR = {
				is_in_array = {
					gov_coalition_array = 3
				}
				is_in_array = {
					gov_coalition_array = 17
				}
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_green_family
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_identity = 5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				check_variable = {
					var = COLDWAR_SWE_old_cabinet
					value = COLDWAR_SWE_cabinet_identity
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		COLDWAR_SWE_last_native_party = ruling_party
	}
}

	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_democratic_socialist
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_independent_communist
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_moscow_communist
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_maoist
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_corporatist_far_right
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_security_nationalist
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_local_autonomy_protected
	set_country_flag = free_allow_parties
	set_partyall_allowed = yes
	set_politics = {
		elections_allowed = yes
	}
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_pluralist_restoration
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_election_result_pending
	hold_election = yes
	COLDWAR_SWE_national_refresh_effect = yes
}
